Check a puzzle solution attempt

Source: R/puzzles.R
gm_check_solution.Rd

Check a puzzle solution attempt

Usage

gm_check_solution(puzzle, moves)

Arguments

puzzle

A gm_puzzle object, as returned by gm_puzzle().

moves

A character vector of attempted moves in standard algebraic notation.

Value

A one-row tibble::tibble() with correct (logical), solved_plies (integer, how many correct moves matched) and total_plies (integer).

See also

Other puzzles: gm_puzzle()

Examples

p <- gm_puzzle(id = "gm-0001")
gm_check_solution(p, character())
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   correct solved_plies total_plies
#>   <lgl>          <int>       <int>
#> 1 FALSE              0           1
gm_check_solution(p, p$solution)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   correct solved_plies total_plies
#>   <lgl>          <int>       <int>
#> 1 TRUE               1           1
